instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure React component files use .js extension as per existing project structure.
2. Implement a theme provider / toggle hook that manages 'dark' class on <html> or <body> element and stores preference in localStorage.
3. Apply crisp data-testid attributes (kebab-case) to all interactive elements, inputs, buttons, context switcher items, tab triggers, filter buttons, and table rows.
4. Ensure Master-Detail view in Org Interviews renders a responsive 2-column pane on desktop (left list, right detail) and single pane collapsible view on mobile.

5. Enforce RBAC rules visually in the interview detail view: ADMIN/HR can perform actions (Edit, Re-invite, Cancel, Delete); VIEWER role sees action buttons disabled or hidden with an informative RBAC tooltip/badge.
6. Build the Resume Upload dropzone with full 5MB validation, drop effect, upload progress skeleton/animation, and error feedback when non-PDF or >5MB files are dropped.
7. Build the Interview Room page at '/app/interview/:id' as a clean WebRTC boundary placeholder with media controls bar and clear notice banner.
8. Strictly avoid prohibited colors (#7351B7 and #1B93A4) and prohibited heading fonts (Inter for headers).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI template looks. Use high-density, sharp-bordered, beautifully spaced cards and lists.
Never center-align the app container or main content globally.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Do not use full transparent backgrounds in headers, popovers, or dropdowns. Always use semi-opaque background with backdrop-blur.
Use Lucide React icons for clean, consistent iconography throughout the application.
Use Sonner for toast notifications (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar).
